doc: smoothstep(a=0.03, b=0.30, x) on a float32 2-D array (the closed-cell edge ramp): a and b are weak python floats, so the arithmetic is float32 and the result float32. The sweep includes float32(a), float32(b), 0, -0 and +-1e30. Tolerance 1e-5/1e-6 (default): measured worst difference against the float64 evaluation of the same inputs 9e-8 (a chain of 6 float32 operations).
